cohort: 87 term pregnant women undergoing a scheduled caesarean section under locoregional anesthesia
finding: A 5 IU bolus of oxytocin during caesarean section was as effective as a 10 IU bolus in achieving uterine tone but resulted in better hemodynamic stability and fewer side effects.
